title.en: Add free trial entry and sentence-builder listening and writing
title.zh: 增加免费试学入口及点词组句听力与写作

purpose.en: Make the existing anonymous Beginner trial easy to find from Play and turn course listening and writing into approachable ten-question word-tile games.
purpose.zh: 让用户可从“边玩边学”直接找到现有匿名初级试学，并把课程听力与写作升级为易用的每轮十题点词组句游戏。

en: Add a prominent Free Trial tile to Play after the learner chooses one of twelve target languages.
Let anonymous learners enter the existing five-skill Beginner trial without signing up or writing progress to an account or database.
Add normal-speed and slow listening controls, shuffled word tiles, an answer workspace, immediate feedback, and ten-question progress.
Add translation-led writing exercises that learners complete by arranging target-language words.
Publish a deterministic 120-sentence bank for every one of the twelve languages and three course levels.
zh: 用户选择十二种目标语言之一后，在“边玩边学”增加醒目的“免费试学”卡片。
访客无需注册即可进入现有五项初级课程试学，进度不写入账户或数据库。
增加正常与慢速听音、乱序词块、组句区、即时反馈及十题进度。
增加按界面语言提示、用目标语言词块完成的写作练习。
为十二种语言、三个课程等级中的每一门课程发布稳定的 120 句练习库。

en: Play language game hub
Anonymous Beginner five-skill trial
Subscribed course listening and writing tabs
Server-reconstructed daily practice scoring
Project release report
zh: 边玩边学语言游戏页
匿名初级五项试学
已订阅课程听力与写作标签
服务器重建式每日练习评分
Project 发布日报

en: Create an original, versioned sentence-exercise module with twelve everyday destinations and ten task patterns per course level.
Select ten unique questions deterministically for each course date while keeping the full 120-item bank stable.
Reuse one responsive sentence-builder component in both anonymous trial and signed-in learning instead of maintaining divergent exercise UIs.
Submit the completed ten-answer round through the existing daily task API and reconstruct the same immutable round on the server before scoring.
Advance the SmartLingo learning content version so prior daily task evidence cannot collide with the new exercise contract.
zh: 新增原创且带版本的句子练习模块，每个课程等级包含十二个生活目的地与十种任务句型。
按课程日期稳定抽取十道不重复题，同时保持完整 120 题库不变。
匿名试学与登录后课程共用一个响应式组句组件，避免两套学习界面分叉。
完成十题后沿用现有每日任务 API 提交，并由服务器重建同一不可变题组后评分。
提升 SmartLingo 学习内容版本，避免旧的每日任务记录与新练习协议冲突。

en: Shared policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and portfolio contract gates pass.
The production build, strict TypeScript check, sensitive-data scan, artifact validation, lint, and all 319 repository tests pass.
Automated contracts verify 36 course banks at exactly 120 unique sentence exercises each and ten unique daily items.
The WebKit runtime layout matrix passes 260/260 combinations across 26 routes, two interface languages, and five phone, iPad, and desktop viewports.
zh: 共享规则、架构、基础功能一致性及全站合约门禁通过。
生产构建、严格 TypeScript 检查、敏感数据扫描、产物验证、代码检查及全部 319 项仓库测试通过。
自动合约确认 36 门课程均恰有 120 道不重复句子练习，每日题组含十道不重复题。
WebKit 运行时布局矩阵 260/260 通过，覆盖 26 条路由、两种界面语言及五种手机、iPad 与桌面视口。

en: Speech synthesis uses each browser's installed target-language voice; voice timbre can differ across Safari, Chrome, Windows, and Android.
zh: 语音合成使用浏览器安装的目标语言语音；Safari、Chrome、Windows 与 Android 的音色可能不同。

en: The new exercise bank stays inside SmartLingo and changes no shared identity, commerce, classroom, or external-service boundary.
zh: 新练习库仅属于 SmartLingo，不改变共享身份、商业、课程教室或外部服务边界。
